This '''plant''' grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] and had a long stalk covered with [[Color/Legends|bluish-purple]] [[Flower/Legends|flowers]]. When touched, the plant caused allergic reactions in most [[Human/Legends|humans]], which came in the form of itch, puffiness and pustules. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], following the advice of [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], used this plant to disguise his appearance from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrols; after being treated with this plant, his face became puffy and unrecognizable.
